about: Instance-token vectors minted by ans-agent scripts/gen_instance_vectors.py from src/instance_token.py; every verdict was checked against the Python verifier.

vectors.name: valid
vectors.description: a fresh token, proof and ACTIVE status token

vectors.name: valid_child_with_act
vectors.description: an RFC 8693 child: sub is the user, act.sub the instance

vectors.name: valid_raw_fingerprint
vectors.description: status token lists the certificate as raw 32 bytes

vectors.name: valid_warning_status
vectors.description: WARNING is a live status

vectors.name: expired
vectors.description: token exp is in the past

vectors.name: bad_token_extra_header
vectors.description: token header carries a parameter outside {alg, typ, x5c}

vectors.name: bad_token_lifetime
vectors.description: token lifetime exceeds 900 s

vectors.name: bad_signature
vectors.description: token signature altered

vectors.name: bad_alg_p384_cert
vectors.description: x5c certificate key is P-384, so cannot be ES256

vectors.name: bad_dpop_wrong_key
vectors.description: proof signed by a key other than cnf.jkt

vectors.name: bad_dpop_ath
vectors.description: proof ath names a different token

vectors.name: bad_dpop_htm
vectors.description: proof htm is GET for a POST

vectors.name: bad_dpop_signature
vectors.description: proof signature altered

vectors.name: bad_dpop_x5c_header
vectors.description: proof header carries x5c (instance proofs are bare jwk)

vectors.name: htu_mismatch
vectors.description: proof htu names another path

vectors.name: clock_skew_dpop
vectors.description: proof iat 500 s in the past

vectors.name: clock_skew_status
vectors.description: status token iat 1000 s ahead

vectors.name: replay
vectors.description: the same proof presented twice; the second is refused

vectors.name: revoked
vectors.description: issuer registration REVOKED

vectors.name: revoked_deprecated
vectors.description: DEPRECATED is refused (only ACTIVE and WARNING pass)

vectors.name: cert_not_listed
vectors.description: x5c certificate is not in validIdentityCerts

vectors.name: cert_expired
vectors.description: x5c certificate outside its validity dates

vectors.name: iss_mismatch_status
vectors.description: status token names another agent

vectors.name: iss_mismatch_cert_san
vectors.description: x5c certificate does not name the token's ans_name

vectors.name: aud_mismatch
vectors.description: token minted for another verifier

vectors.name: bad_status_token_unpinned
vectors.description: status token signed by an unpinned key

vectors.name: status_expired
vectors.description: status token exp is in the past

vectors.name: depth_exceeded_nested_act
vectors.description: act nests a second actor; one delegation hop is allowed

vectors.name: valid_empty_body
vectors.description: an empty body bound by the empty-content digest

vectors.name: bad_dpop_no_content_digest
vectors.description: an empty body and a proof with no ans_content_digest

vectors.name: bad_dpop_body_rewritten
vectors.description: the body differs from the one the proof covers

vectors.name: status_fresh_under_max_age
vectors.description: status token 100 s old, maxStatusAge 300 s

vectors.name: status_stale
vectors.description: status token 400 s old, maxStatusAge 300 s

vectors.name: status_future_iat_under_max_age
vectors.description: status token iat 61 s ahead; maxStatusAge caps the future skew at 60 s

vectors.name: status_future_iat_unbounded
vectors.description: status token iat 61 s ahead is within the default 600 s
